hydration_deficit.description: Shortage of body water. 0 is well hydrated, 1 is the extreme.

energy_deficit.description: Shortage of food energy. 0 is satisfied, 1 is starving.

fatigue.description: Tiredness from effort and lack of rest.

glycemic_level.description: Blood glucose, scaled from a low-normal to a clearly high value.

blood_pressure_level.description: Blood pressure, scaled from normal to a clearly high value.

mobility_loss.description: Loss of the ability to move, from joints, muscles or nerves.

infection_burden.description: How much infection the body carries and how ill it makes the person.

frailty.description: Overall loss of reserve. Models mostly give it a rate, not a variable.

oxygen_deficit.description: Shortage of oxygen in the blood, from thin air, damaged lungs or poisoning. 0 is normal saturation, 1 is severe.

nutrient_deficit.description: Lack of a vitamin or mineral the body cannot make, as in scurvy, beriberi or goitre. 0 is well supplied, 1 is the pool run dry.

mood_valence.description: How bad the person feels, in valence. 0 is good, 1 is the worst. Models mostly give it a rate.

psychological_strain.description: Stress, homesickness and the weight of circumstances.

loneliness.description: Lack of company felt by the person.

food_intake.description: Food eaten at a meal, in grams.

carb_intake.description: Carbohydrate reaching the gut, in grams per step as the consuming model expects.

medication_dose.description: Dose of the medicine a model is built around.

sleep_duration.description: Hours of sleep per night, as the consuming model expects.

psychological_demand.description: Load of stress put on the person, from 0 for none to 1 for constant extreme pressure.

injury_exposure.description: How exposed the person is to wounds, from 0 for a safe place to 1 for war or dangerous labour.

pathogen_exposure.description: Intensity of exposure to a pathogen, worked out by the game for a place and a time.

social_recognition.description: How far the society of a time and place recognises the person, for example by sex. The game picks the parameter set.
